    mc0, mc1 = min(c for r, c in mark), max(c for r, c in mark)
    # The 6-shape's symmetry axis determines the reflection axis.
    mset = set(mark)
    horiz = all((2 * mr0 + mr1 - r, c) in mset for r, c in mark) if (mr1-mr0) % 2 == 0 else all((mr0+mr1-r, c) in mset for r,c in mark)
    vert = all((r, 2 * mc0 + mc1 - c) in mset for r, c in mark) if (mc1-mc0) % 2 == 0 else all((r, mc0+mc1-c) in mset for r,c in mark)
    # Prefer the unique symmetry axis; horizontal axis means reflect vertically,
    # vertical axis means reflect horizontally.
    if horiz and not vert:

    else:
